edges.reason: constructor assigns manager = msg.sender, making the caller permanently privileged
enter() pushes msg.sender into the players array
isNotManager gates execution on msg.sender != manager
isManager gates pickWinner on msg.sender == manager
isNotInList attempts (incorrectly) to check msg.sender against the players list
enter() is guarded by the isNotManager modifier
enter() is guarded by the isNotInList modifier
enter() is guarded by the validValue modifier (exact 0.01 ether)
pickWinner() is guarded by the isManager modifier
pickWinner() is guarded by the isAnyPlayers modifier
random() seeds the hash with now, so the result depends on block.timestamp
weak randomness is directly derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty
random() hashes the players array and takes modulo players.length
pickWinner() calls random() to obtain the winning index
the manipulable random value becomes the local index
index = random() stores the pseudo-random result
winner is selected with an index derived from timestamp-dependent randomness, allowing winner manipulation
winner = players[index] reads the players array
transfer recipient players[index] comes from the players array
manager.transfer(share) sends value to the manager state variable
the transferred amount this.balance - share is computed with unchecked multiplication/division
pickWinner() computes share = this.balance * 20 / 100 without SafeMath
pickWinner() performs the external transfer to the winner
pickWinner() performs the external transfer to the manager
pickWinner() resets players = new address[](0) after the transfers
entryPlayers() returns the players array
external transfer to the winner can re-enter enter() before state is cleared
value transfer to an attacker-controlled winner occurs before players is reset and before winner commits, enabling re-entrant draw

normalization_plan.reason: local index carries no independent behaviour; it only materialises the value returned by random(), so it folds into the random() core function
local share is only an intermediate value consumed by pickWinner()'s transfers and has no independent behaviour, so it folds into the pickWinner core function
